articles.headline: Nvidia launches safety platform to keep AI agents from going rogue
articles.summary: Nvidia released an open-source safety platform for AI agents that adds monitoring and containment controls for enterprise deployments. The move matters to businesses because it targets a growing operational and cybersecurity risk in AI automation, and it could influence how companies deploy agentic systems across internal workflows and customer-facing tools.

articles.headline: Cerebras to supply AI systems to cloud startup Gimlet Labs
articles.summary: Cerebras announced a supply deal with cloud startup Gimlet Labs aimed at speeding up AI inference. For businesses, faster inference can lower response times and improve the economics of AI use cases such as cybersecurity, voice applications, and financial analysis.

articles.headline: Nvidia unveils tools to secure AI agents for enterprise use
articles.summary: Nvidia introduced tools that combine software and hardware safeguards for AI agents, including monitoring and containment features for enterprise environments. This is business-relevant because it may reduce deployment risk and help companies adopt AI agents in regulated or security-sensitive workflows.
